$comment: Reviewed exceptions to the npm audit gate (scripts/check-audit.mjs, run by .github/workflows/validate.yml). The gate fails on every high or critical advisory except one listed here.

An entry is justified only when no patched release exists and the vulnerable code is reached solely through a dev tool handling this repository's own input. Each names the advisory, the package, the reason and a review_by date; past that date the gate fails again until someone re-checks for a fix. Remove an entry as soon as a fixed release can be installed.

exceptions.reason: No patched release: the advisory covers braces <=3.0.3 and 3.0.3 is the latest published version (checked 2026-10-04). Reached only via markdownlint-cli2 -> globby -> fast-glob -> micromatch, expanding the repository's own glob patterns (**/*.md and the ignore list), never outside input; a stack-exhaustion DoS here can only crash a local lint run.
